newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP pledges rigorous project assessments.
newsitem.headline: BHP pledges rigorous project assessments.

text.p: Australia's The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Monday that too often it had seen good operating performances fail to flow into good profits and it pledged to rigorously assess new projects and acquisitions.
BHP managing director John Prescott also said the group would benchmark its performance against the world's best.
"We are categorising our businesses into five sets in order to understand where they are in the maturity curve...where we should put our focus," he told a briefing seminar.

He listed the top performers as the Bass Strait and North West Shelf oil and gas operations in Australian waters, the Escondida copper mine in Chile, iron ore and coal operations and flat products in steel.
